name: Chandigarh
summary: India's first planned modern city post-independence, designed by Swiss-French architect Le Corbusier. Serves as the joint capital of Punjab and Haryana while functioning as a Union Territory.
festivals: Rose Festival, Mango Festival, Chandigarh Carnival
monuments: The Capitol Complex (UNESCO World Heritage Site), Rock Garden of Nek Chand, Sukhna Lake, Zakir Hussain Rose Garden

mcqs.q: Who was the master architect and urban planner who designed the modernist layout and Capitol Complex of Chandigarh?
mcqs.exp: Swiss-French architect Le Corbusier designed the master plan and government buildings of Chandigarh in the 1950s.

mcqs.q: The world-famous Rock Garden in Chandigarh was secretly created out of recycled industrial and domestic waste by which visionary?
mcqs.exp: Nek Chand spent nearly two decades secretly building the 40-acre sculpture park from discarded urban scrap.
